title: Bulava of the Rada vs Chonae Wing
lede:
Chonae Wing won 38-10 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, holding all three objectives in Rounds 3 and 4 without losing a single unit.

It was decided in Round 2, when the two Michaelite Brethren landed on their charges and destroyed Host Sotnia 1, Host Sotnia 2 and both their leaders in two attacks, worth 7 VP that round from MAN OF THE HOUR and ERADICATE THE FOE, and the Cossacks never held the centre or the left again.
result_line: Chonae Wing win 38-10 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Bulava of the Rada, all MOUNTED, set up on row 13 around its HQ at (7,13): Ivan Sirko (Mounted) with Terek Shashka Riders 1 at (9,13), the Host Osaul with Host Sotnia 1 at (4,13), the Kharakternyk with Host Sotnia 2 at (3,13), Terek Shashka Riders 2 at (6,13) and Host Sotnia 3 at (11,13). Chonae Wing set up on row 2 around its HQ at (7,1): five Covenant Levies from (4,2) to (10,2), the Saint-Militant at (5,2), and the two Michaelite Brethren, each led by a Seraphic Justiciar, at (3,2) and (11,2); the Brethren and the Saint-Militant began the battle in the air. The set-up gave the Cossacks the first move to the objectives (they had Priority every round with fewer units) against a Covenant line of 10 RP Levies with three flying melee units behind it.

1.title: The Cossacks ride onto two objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: RAISE THE STANDARD for the Bulava, which planted its standard at (0,10) in its own half, and ERADICATE THE FOE for Chonae Wing. Secondaries kept: DEEP REACH and MAN OF THE HOUR. The Bulava spent 1 CP on a Scouting Order for Terek Shashka Riders 1 (it bought nothing); Chonae Wing spent its 3 CP on Troop Requisition, a sixth Covenant Levies at (8,2).

Everything Advanced. Terek Shashka Riders 1 with Ivan Sirko reached the centre at (8,7), Host Sotnia 2 with the Kharakternyk the left at (2,7), with Terek Shashka Riders 2 behind at (2,8) and Host Sotnia 1 at (5,7). Host Sotnia 3 rode sideways along the back row to (5,13). The Covenant Levies came up to rows 4 and 5; Michaelite Brethren 1 flew to (8,8), Michaelite Brethren 2 to (4,6) and the Saint-Militant to (6,6), all still in the air.
Nothing: every unit had Advanced. Chonae Wing's PRAYING gave it 11 Mana.
The Bulava held the centre on OC 9 vs 0 and the left on OC 11 vs 0 (5 VP), and DEEP REACH paid 3. 8-0.

2.title: The Brethren land: four Cossack units gone in two attacks

feed.text: The Bulava spent all 5 CP on Troop Requisition for Kuban Plastuns at (7,12); Chonae Wing held its 3. Secondaries kept: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and DEEP REACH.

Covenant Levies 3 walked onto the left at (0,6) under the Fortitude Miracle and drew four Cossack Overwatches (the Host Osaul and Host Sotnia 2 put 2 each into it). Each Cossack Overwatch triggered Riders of the Wild Fields, and the free moves scattered the Host: Host Sotnia 3 to (12,7) on the right objective, Host Sotnia 1 with the Osaul to (10,6) and then (12,8), Terek Shashka Riders 2 to (3,7). Host Sotnia 1 then used its own move to ride back to (7,8), beside Michaelite Brethren 1 (Covenant Levies 1's Overwatch did 3). Both Brethren's Overwatches were skipped: the FREE Paradiso Pistol was marked used and never rolled. Terek Shashka Riders 1 and Ivan Sirko charged Covenant Levies 1 and 4 at (9,5). Then Chonae Wing's flyers landed on their charges: Michaelite Brethren 1 at (8,9) on the Host Osaul and Host Sotnia 1, Michaelite Brethren 2 at (0,7) on the Kharakternyk and Host Sotnia 2, and the Saint-Militant at (11,7) on Host Sotnia 3.

Terek Shashka Riders 1 put 16 into Covenant Levies 4 (20 to 4) and Ivan Sirko 8 into Covenant Levies 1 (18 to 10); neither died. Then, under the Exaltation Miracle, Michaelite Brethren 1 rolled 9 hits with its Flame-Tipped Spears: Host Sotnia 1 and the Host Osaul destroyed (12 and 6), MAN OF THE HOUR complete (+4 VP, +1 CP). Michaelite Brethren 2 did the same with 6 hits: Host Sotnia 2 and the Kharakternyk destroyed (11 and 5). Host Sotnia 3 attacked the Saint-Militant, which struck first for 9 (15 to 6) and took 1. Covenant Levies 2 and 3 shot Terek Shashka Riders 2 for 7 and 1 (20 to 12).

Chonae Wing took the centre (OC 10 vs 0) and the left (OC 17 vs 3), 5 VP; Host Sotnia 3 held the right for the Bulava (2). ERADICATE THE FOE paid 3 for four kills in Objective Areas and DEEP REACH 3. 10-15.

3.title: Covenant on all three objectives; the standard falls

feed.text: Chonae Wing spent all 7 CP: Troop Requisition for a seventh Covenant Levies at (7,2) (3, bought nothing), Double Time for Michaelite Brethren 2 (2, which bought no move but completed COMMAND AUTHORITY, +2 VP, as the Brethren stood in the enemy half) and Rally Cry via the HQ for Covenant Levies 4's Morale Test (2). Benediction healed the Saint-Militant 1 HP. The Bulava spent its 2 CP on Rally Cry via Ivan Sirko for Host Sotnia 3. Secondaries kept: IRON GRIP and COMMAND AUTHORITY.

Covenant Levies 1 broke away from Terek Shashka Riders 1 cleanly to (12,3), and Covenant Levies 4 broke away in disorder (1 True Damage) to (13,3). Terek Shashka Riders 2 charged Covenant Levies 5 at (3,6), which broke away to (7,6) onto the centre. Both Brethren then charged Terek Shashka Riders 2, from (7,8) to (4,7) and from (0,8) to (2,7). Covenant Levies 3 walked to (0,9), next to the Bulava's standard.

Terek Shashka Riders 2 swung at Michaelite Brethren 2 and missed with all 6 dice; Seraphic Justiciar 2's counterattack did 8 and BURNED them and the Brethren's did 4: Terek Shashka Riders 2 destroyed. The Saint-Militant killed Host Sotnia 3 (6) and took ground to (12,7). Terek Shashka Riders 1, whose engagers had fled, had no legal action, and Ivan Sirko channelled 4 Mana. The Kuban Plastuns' three shots at the airborne Michaelite Brethren 1 all missed (-1 HIT vs FLYING).
Chonae Wing held all three objectives, OC 20, 9 and 3 (7 VP), and ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2. Covenant Levies 3 tore the Bulava's standard down. 10-26.

4.title: Ivan Sirko's last charge, and 38 VP

feed.text: Neither side spent CP (2 and 3 held). The Bulava kept PROBING STRIKE and picked the right objective at (13,7) for Chonae Wing's TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET.

The Kuban Plastuns moved to (6,8) and lost 4 of their 6 HP to Covenant Levies' Overwatch. Terek Shashka Riders 1 and Ivan Sirko charged Covenant Levies 5 and Covenant Levies at (8,6); both broke away in disorder (1 True Damage each), to (5,5) and (8,8). Michaelite Brethren 1 landed at (7,7) on Ivan Sirko, the Riders and the Plastuns; Michaelite Brethren 2 at (5,7) on the Plastuns. Covenant Levies 4 walked onto the right at (12,6).

Terek Shashka Riders 1 hit Michaelite Brethren 1 for 6 (12 to 6), and the counterattacks of Seraphic Justiciar 1 (4) and the Brethren (8) took the Riders to 8 and BURNED them and Ivan Sirko. Michaelite Brethren 2 destroyed the Kuban Plastuns (2). Ivan Sirko's Kosh Bulava did 2 more to Michaelite Brethren 1 (6 to 4). Covenant Levies 2 shot the Bulava's HQ for 4. BURNED then took 2 from each of Ivan Sirko and the Riders.
Chonae Wing held the centre (OC 15 vs 6), the left (OC 8) and the right (OC 5), 7 VP to 33, past the 30 VP target. ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3. 10-38.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Chonae Wing scored 19 objective VP (the centre and the left from Round 2, all three in Rounds 3 and 4), 7 from ERADICATE THE FOE and 12 from four secondaries, every one it kept: MAN OF THE HOUR (4), DEEP REACH (3), COMMAND AUTHORITY (2) and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (3). Bulava of the Rada scored all 10 of its VP in the first two rounds: 7 from objectives and 3 from DEEP REACH. Its Primary, RAISE THE STANDARD, paid nothing.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The two Michaelite Brethren won it. Each flies, lands on its charge, strikes first (INI 8 +3 on the charge) with Flame-Tipped Spears at MS 9; in Round 2 they took out four units, the Host Osaul with Host Sotnia 1 and the Kharakternyk with Host Sotnia 2, in two attacks, 18 and 16 HP. Between them they did 48 damage, killed six of the Bulava's seven lost units, and scored 13.3 VP. The Saint-Militant killed Host Sotnia 3 and held the right (6.5 VP). The 10 RP Covenant Levies did the holding: the one bought with Troop Requisition in Round 1 scored 7.8 VP (77.5 per 100 RP) on the centre, and Chonae Wing lost no unit at all.

For the Bulava, Terek Shashka Riders 1 did 22 damage (16 into Covenant Levies 4 in Round 2) and Ivan Sirko (Mounted), 75 RP, did 10; neither killed anything: the two Levies they cut down in Round 2 broke away in Round 3, and Michaelite Brethren 1 lived through Round 4 on 4 HP. The Host Sotnias, the army's OC, did 5 damage between them and all three were dead by the end of Round 3.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Bulava could not do

Its mounted squads are 15 HP units that have to stand next to the enemy to hold an objective, and the Brethren and the Saint-Militant reach anything within a flying charge. Once the Host was gone the Bulava had too little OC: in Round 4 Ivan Sirko and the Riders put 6 on the centre against 15. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY, IRON GRIP (7 OC on one objective) and PROBING STRIKE (attacks on three units in the enemy half) were out of reach with Ivan Sirko, one Riders squad and a 6 HP Plastun squad. RAISE THE STANDARD scores only with a friendly unit beside the standard, and no Cossack unit went within 1 square of (0,10) before Covenant Levies 3 tore it down in Round 3.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • The standard: the AI planted it at (0,10), in the Bulava's own half and away from every unit's path. Planted in the enemy half it would have paid 2 VP a round with a unit beside it; where it stood it paid nothing, and nobody was sent to it.
  • Round 2, Host Sotnia 1: the Riders of the Wild Fields moves took it to (12,8) beside the right objective, and its own move then took it back to (7,8), next to Michaelite Brethren 1, where it died with the Osaul. The moves-undone record lists it.
  • Round 2, Kuban Plastuns: 5 CP, the Bulava's whole pool, for a 6 HP squad that made one attack (no damage) before it died in Round 4.
  • Engine bug: in Round 2 both Michaelite Brethren's Overwatch spent the FREE Paradiso Pistol and then skipped it ("skipped - FREE weapon already used this Battle Round"), so neither rolled a die at Terek Shashka Riders 2 or Host Sotnia 1. It cost Chonae Wing damage it did not need.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes: Covenant Levies' Round 2 "risky hold" lists Ivan Sirko and Terek Shashka Riders 1 as engagers while they were at (9,5), three squares away, and Covenant Levies 3's "risky hold" and Michaelite Brethren 2's "held" in Round 3 list Terek Shashka Riders 2 before it had reached either.
  • Chonae Wing finished with 29 Mana it never spent and no MAGIC_CASTER to spend it; its four Miracles drew nothing from it in the log. The Bulava's Scouting Order in Round 1 and Chonae Wing's last Troop Requisition and Double Time in Round 3 bought nothing.

This looks like the army more than the AI. The AI's standard and Host Sotnia 1's ride home made it worse, but MOUNTED 15 HP squads that must stand on objectives are prey for three flying units that charge first, and the Covenant's cheap Levies had OC to spare.

closing: The Cossacks were first to the objectives and up 8-0 after a round. Then the Michaelite Brethren landed among the Host, and the Bulava, losing a unit or two every round, did not score again. Chonae Wing ended the battle in Round 4 with every unit it had brought still on the board.
